server.connectCommand: tmux new-session -A -s fin-agentd \; set status off
server._environment_note: Optional extra SSH env requests for the PTY channel; sshd must AcceptEnv them (macOS and Debian/Ubuntu default: LANG LC_*; RHEL-family sshd, Amazon Linux included, enumerates locale names and needs AcceptEnv LC_FIN_AGENT added — check with sshd -T). LC_FIN_AGENT=1 is ALWAYS sent whether or not it is listed here — an entry for it changes the value, never removes it. See README: The session marker.

task: Watch the build in this terminal; if it fails, summarize the first error. When the build has finished successfully, end your reply with TASK COMPLETE.

supervision._note: Presigned URLs MUST be SigV4 — boto3 Config(signature_version='s3v4'). A SigV2 URL 403s any PUT because the daemon sends a Content-Type header.
supervision._inboxResetAtLaunch_note: true ONLY when whatever launches this daemon empties the inbox document first (the control plane's POST /workers does; launch.sh and a resident install do not). It exempts the inbox from the first-run seed; false/absent seeds the inbox backlog as history on a first run. See README: Remote supervision.

controlPlane._note: Optional. Present, request-input and task-complete events become APNs pushes via the control plane's POST /notify; absent, the daemon stays silent. The token is ~/.fin-control-plane-token on the deploy machine.
